description: $7,500 is the 2026 Roth IRA limit ($8,600 at 50+). This Roth IRA calculator applies the MAGI phase-out and the FEIE rule for expats, then projects growth. Web page: https://calcbright.com/roth-ira-calculator

compensation.description: Earned income that counts (optional) Wages or self-employment income you are taxed on – salary excluded under the FEIE does not count. Joint filers: both spouses’ combined. Leave blank if it is above the limit.

magi.description: Modified AGI (MAGI) Living abroad? Add back any foreign earned income or housing amounts you exclude on Form 2555.

taxRate.description: Tax on gains in a taxable account (%) Applied to growth each year – e.g. 15% long-term capital-gains rate.
